{{Top|leg}}
'''Nunbar''' was an individual who was a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. After learning that [[A9G-series Data Storage Unit]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were being bought in large numbers on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], Nunbar posted to the Datalog that they had a source for the droids and interested parties could contact them on [[StarForge Station]] to arrange a deal. Nunbar noted that the price for the droids was good, and the risk low.<ref name="CB">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
